label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Subject: Lotus Glow Nails is OK (and so am I!)

Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and my ladies,

You probably heard already, because my phone has not stopped ringing. Early Sunday morning, November 8, around 2am, a car drove right through the front window of Lotus Glow Nails on Bellaire Blvd.

The important part first: nobody was hurt. The shop was empty, the driver is okay, the police came, and her insurance is paying. I cried a little in the morning, but I am fine now. God protected us, because nobody was inside.

The front glass is gone and one pedicure chair is smashed. The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she wanted a spa day. My daughter says the driver got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston. The floor looks like a rainbow threw up. My husband says after 11 years the shop is finally modern art.

Here is what everybody keeps asking me:

When do we reopen?
Monday, November 16. That is what the contractor says. The city inspector has to check the wall first, so if anything changes I will let you know.

Where can I get my nails done this week?
Trang, Kim, and I are working at my cousin Hoa's salon, Pearland Nail Bar. Call or text my cell at 832-555-0147 and we will find a time for you.

What about my gift card?
Still good. Nobody loses any money.

Thank you for all the texts and the food. Mrs. Dung brought pho this morning, so I am being well taken care of. Please don't worry about me. Laugh a little, then come get your nails done.

Please pass this along to anybody who is asking.

With love,
[your name]
Lotus Glow Nails

Just add your name at the bottom before you send it. If you paste it into a group text, leave off the subject line at the top.
